capabilities: transform indented text into a rendered directory tree
support nesting with spaces or tabs
place files under their parent directories in the tree
disambiguation: It does not manage or display the vault's real folders; it renders directory trees written inside note content.
extras: The README's credit line is truncated and does not name the plugin or author being credited.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to turn plain indented text into a readable directory tree inside a note.
summary: Renders indented Markdown text as a visually formatted directory tree using tabs, spaces and line breaks.
